paragraphs.text: 1. As, like the Morning, thou hast filled, O Indra, both the earth and heaven.
So as the Mighty One, great King of all the mighty world of men, the Goddess Mother brought thee forth, the Blessed Mother gave thee life.
paragraphs.original: महान्तं त्वा महीनां सम्राजं चर्षणीनां देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत्
paragraphs.translit: mahāntaṃ tvā mahīnāṃ samrājaṃ carṣaṇīnāṃ devī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat

paragraphs.text: 2. Relax that mortal's stubborn strength whose heart is bent on wickedness.
paragraphs.original: अव स्म दुर्हणायतो मर्तस्य तनुहि स्थिरम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ava sma durhaṇāyato martasya tanuhi sthiram |

paragraphs.text: Trample him down beneath thy feet who watches for and aims at us. The Goddess Mother brought thee forth, the Blessed Mother gave thee life.
paragraphs.original: अधस्पदं तमीं कृधि यो अस्माँ आदिदेशति देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत्
paragraphs.translit: adhaspadaṃ tamīṃ kṛdhi yo asmām̐ ādideśati devī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat

paragraphs.text: 3. Shake down, O Slayer of the foe, those great all splendid enemies.
With all thy powers, O Sakra, all thine helps, O Indra, shake them down:
paragraphs.original: शचीभिः शक्र धूनुहीन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिर्देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत्
paragraphs.translit: śacībhiḥ śakra dhūnuhīndra viśvābhirūtibhirdevī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat

paragraphs.text: 4. As thou, O Satakratu, thou, O Indrv, shakest all things down
As wealth for him who sheds the juice, with thine assistance thousandfold.
paragraphs.original: रयिं न सुन्वते सचा सहस्रिणीभिरूतिभिर्देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत्
paragraphs.translit: rayiṃ na sunvate sacā sahasriṇībhirūtibhirdevī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat

paragraphs.text: 5. Around, on every side like drops of sweat let lightning-flashes fall.
Let all malevolence pass away from us like threads of Darva grass.
paragraphs.original: दूर्वाया इव तन्तवो व्यस्मदेतु दुर्मतिर्देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत्
paragraphs.translit: dūrvāyā iva tantavo vyasmadetu durmatirdevī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat

paragraphs.text: 6. Thou bearest in thine hand a lance like a long hook, great Counsellor!
paragraphs.original: दीर्घं ह्यङ्कुशं यथा शक्तिं बिभर्षि मन्तुमः ।
paragraphs.translit: dīrghaṃ hyaṅkuśaṃ yathā śaktiṃ bibharṣi mantumaḥ |

paragraphs.text: As with his foremost foot a goat, draw down the branch, O Maghavan.
paragraphs.original: पूर्वेण मघवन्पदाजो वयां यथा यमो देवी जनित्र्यजीजनद्भद्रा जनित्र्यजीजनत्
paragraphs.translit: pūrveṇa maghavanpadājo vayāṃ yathā yamo devī janitryajījanadbhadrā janitryajījanat

paragraphs.text: 7. Never, O Gods, do we offend, nor are we ever obstinate: we walk as holy texts command.
paragraphs.original: नकिर्देवा मिनीमसि नकिरा योपयामसि मन्त्रश्रुत्यं चरामसि ।
paragraphs.translit: nakirdevā minīmasi nakirā yopayāmasi mantraśrutyaṃ carāmasi |

paragraphs.text: Closely we clasp and cling to you, cling to your sides, beneath your arms.
